en.versionNote: The first screen is the decision. Metrics holds the other numbers. Checks lists every constraint.
en.emptyHint: Run a scenario to compare the current plan with the reschedule.
en.otdTip: Lots finished by their due time, divided by lots on the plan.
en.tardyTip: Sum of lateness, weighted by priority. A held lot is not given a finish time.
en.riskTip: Lots that miss their due time, including lots the plan could not place. Priority 1 and 2.
en.spanTip: Finish of the last step on that plan.
en.leadTip: Mean time from the shift clock to completion, for lots the plan finishes. Held lots are omitted.
en.waitTip: Mean gap between consecutive steps of the same lot.
en.utilTip: One window for both plans: the longer makespan. Busy time divided by the time tools are up.
en.xTip: Mean completion time divided by raw process time. 1.0 is all processing. Held lots are omitted.
en.changeTip: Setups charged because the recipe family changed.
en.qtimeNote: End of one step to the start of the next.
en.qtimeTip: Pairs that start inside the limit, including pairs past 80 percent of it. Holds and violations are the misses.
en.violationTip: Placed pairs whose gap is longer than the limit.
en.atRiskTip: Placed pairs still inside the limit, past 80 percent of it.
en.bottleneckNote: Most remaining minutes per up-tool minute, over one day. Down tools add no time.
en.bottleneckTip: Same-priority work in this area, and the step that feeds it, is dispatched first.
en.areaTip: Busy time in this area divided by up-time in this area, on the shared window.
en.waitPair: Mean gap from {from} to {to} on the new plan, across {n} lots.
en.tardyCellTip: Lateness before, then after. A held lot is not given a finish time.
en.movedTip: Lots whose tool changed on a step that exists in both plans.
en.downTip: Minutes down or in maintenance inside the shared window. Left out of the utilization denominator.
en.progressTip: Steps finished, out of the six in the recovery.
en.dueTip: Due time of a priority-1 lot, on the same scale as the bars.
en.heldOut: Held lots left this figure. It is not a win.
en.verifyLead: One row per check. Open a row for the reason.
en.figuresNote: Gray is not a direction. A hold cannot turn a shorter plan green.
en.waitNote: Largest gaps on the new plan.
en.lotNote: The step whose tool changed. The first tool if the lot did not move.
en.lotNoteScale: Steps whose tool differs from EDD dispatch. First 12.
